title: Sources for second-order semantics
sources_and_specific_support: Avigad 2002 §8.3, 101–106, supplies relation-variable semantics, full and restricted relation domains, and comprehension. Inspect the actual many-sorted translation and any calculus or no-effective-complete-calculus argument before adopting them. The existing Henkin witness construction for first-order completeness is not by itself a semantics for second-order variables.
